Mind over matter is rather easy, but mind over mind takes a deft touch. Humanity is seemingly always trying to the kick the ghost of idealism out the door, to no lasting avail. It seems to always rear its rather beautiful head time and again. The ugly duckling that is materialism safeguards us from some of the harder truths of life, the mind-over-mind truths, which reduce the grounding power of thought to nil. Paradoxically enough, materialism is there to safeguard the efficacy of conceptuality, for it gives mind and concept something definite to cling to. Idealism turns all into wispy veil and thirsty vapour, the great mist of the Great Mind, revealing thought, and all it deems true, to be of the nature of awesome spuriousity. So is the fare of the finite revealed to be a modality of the infinite - what seemed a thing is, in one fell swoop, dissolved and exalted literally beyond measure.
